newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht edges up, interbank rate firms late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht edges up, interbank rate firms late.

text.p: The baht was slightly firmer in late trade on Wednesday as tighter liquidity prompted selling of the U.S. unit for the baht, dealers said.
The baht was stronger to 25.950/25.955 to the dollar late from 25.951/25.956 in early morning, dealers said.
"The dollar was heavily sold today especially in the afternoon because liquidity began to tighten," said one dealer at a European bank.
The overnight interbank rate was up to 9.25-9.75 percent late from 8.50-9.00 percent in the morning on rising demand for funds, dealers said.
Dealers said the money supply was tightening as some banks were borrowing early for the next reserve requirement which comes due next week.
"Some funds also flew out of the system to pay for the valued added tax," said one money market dealer.
The VAT payment has to be made in the middle of every month.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was higher to 11.00/12.00 satangs per dollar late from 10.50/11.50 in early morning.
